recommendation: Keep the empty audit commit. No source edit is needed unless a future work group decision changes the recommendation into a stronger cross-operation conformance requirement.
issue_request: FHIR-29211 requested that expressions evaluated by operations be able to access operation parameter fields, originally suggesting a generic environment-variable approach. The accepted resolution was to add discussion about PlanDefinition/$apply and ActivityDefinition/$apply parameter access and suggest that as a general pattern for operations that evaluate logic.
initial_application: Commit 96ae6fe19d929585aa3b10e1257887adf15b9557, referenced from the Jira comments and PR 2834, added the current general guidance paragraph to source/clinicalreasoning-topics-using-expressions.html. The specific PlanDefinition/$apply and ActivityDefinition/$apply operation definitions and resource notes already document percent-prefixed parameter context variables for dynamicValue expressions.
additional_context: Pre-resolution FHIR-I minutes recorded concern about collisions with generic percent variables and assigned the topic to Bryn after moving related work toward CDS. Jira comments narrowed the request from a blanket FHIRPath statement to an operation-level recommendation. The relevant source is in build scope: source/fhir.ini lists ActivityDefinition, PlanDefinition, Questionnaire, and QuestionnaireResponse as active resources, and source/hierarchy.xml includes clinicalreasoning-topics-using-expressions.html as the active Clinical Reasoning Using Expressions page. QuestionnaireResponse guidance already covers launchContext/name-based variables for questionnaire expression evaluation.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The active Clinical Reasoning page already says operations SHOULD make operation parameters available as expression context variables, and the ActivityDefinition/$apply and PlanDefinition/$apply source already documents the specific percent-prefixed parameter variables requested by the resolution.
